name: timing-pulley
why: An approximate GT2 profile, marked as approximate in the script. It measures what the approximation actually produces so a change to it is visible. Its grooves sit exactly on the pitch circle, so the edge and curve counts move with the placement arithmetic while the volume does not. The 16 mm height is the hub the grub screw is tapped into: a radial hole that enters once and opens into the bore, where it used to be centred on the axis and drilled out both sides through the top face. The flanges are unioned after the teeth are cut, so twenty groove cylinders cannot perforate them.
